findings.issue: Non-atomic approve→promote→revert cycle. No transaction wrapping the approve + promotion + conditional revert sequence.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the entire approve→promote→revert cycle in a DB transaction (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK).

findings.issue: Migration 010 CHECK constraint only allows 3 request_types but app code uses all 7. Insert with new types fails if 011 hasn't run.
findings.recommendation: Collapse the full 7-value CHECK into 010 or ensure migrations are atomic.

findings.issue: Double-promotion race in bulk actions — same resource approved concurrently fires duplicate promotions.
findings.recommendation: Add check-then-act guard or use DB-level advisory lock per resource.

findings.issue: Stale existingPatterns dedup context — loaded once at start of runAggregation, not refreshed between scanners.
findings.recommendation: Refresh existingPatterns after each scanner completes, or use DB-level dedup.

findings.issue: TOCTOU gap in autoFlag — checks status then updates, but concurrent calls can double-flag.
findings.recommendation: Use UPDATE ... WHERE status = 'new' RETURNING to make check-and-update atomic.

findings.issue: handleRuleProposal uses wrong fallback for createdBy (uses requesterId which may be null for auto-flagged).
findings.recommendation: Use auth.userId or the team owner as fallback when requesterId is null.

findings.issue: Non-atomic pattern-to-rule promotion — INSERT rule + UPDATE pattern status not in transaction.
findings.recommendation: Wrap in BEGIN/COMMIT transaction.

findings.issue: Lost update on concurrent decisions.md writes — read-modify-write without locking.
findings.recommendation: Use SELECT FOR UPDATE or advisory lock before read-modify-write.

findings.issue: handleGetPattern fetches all 200 patterns to find one by ID — false 404 for patterns beyond limit.
findings.recommendation: Replace with direct DB query: SELECT * FROM aggregated_patterns WHERE id = $1 AND team_id = $2.

findings.issue: Missing migration 012 — gap in sequence (010→011→013). Migration runners may halt.
findings.recommendation: Create placeholder 012 or renumber 013 to 012.

findings.issue: Duplicate notifications — approve action fires approval_approved + promotion fires rule_promoted. 2N notifications for N bulk approvals.
findings.recommendation: Skip approval_approved notification when promotion already sent rule_promoted, or deduplicate.

findings.issue: generateAnonId uses 32-bit hash — collision space too small. Duplicate patterns cause unique violation crash.
findings.recommendation: Use crypto.randomUUID() instead of deterministic hash.

findings.issue: Redundant identical ternary — condition true and false branches are the same expression.
findings.recommendation: Remove the ternary and use the expression directly.

findings.issue: Unused 'content' variable declared but never read.
findings.recommendation: Remove the unused variable.

findings.issue: Inline require() calls inside handler function instead of top-level.
findings.recommendation: Move require() to top of file for clarity and caching.

findings.issue: Same expression in both ternary branches (duplicates s-002).
findings.recommendation: Remove ternary.

findings.issue: In-memory debounce only works per-Lambda-instance — multiple concurrent instances bypass.
findings.recommendation: Use DB timestamp-based dedup or distributed lock.

findings.issue: Unused 'content' variable (duplicates s-003).
findings.recommendation: Remove unused variable.

findings.issue: generateAnonId 32-bit hash space limited (duplicates int-004 at medium severity).
findings.recommendation: Use crypto.randomUUID().

findings.issue: rulesCount per-project is actually team-scoped — misleading metric.
findings.recommendation: Scope query to project or rename metric to teamRulesCount.

findings.issue: avg_hours null vs 0 distinction lost — COALESCE maps both to 0.
findings.recommendation: Return null for avg_hours when no data, 0 only when actual average is 0.

findings.issue: Unsanitized n.type interpolated into CSS class and onclick attributes.
findings.recommendation: Whitelist-validate type client-side or use data-* attributes with delegated listeners.

findings.issue: Inline onclick interpolation with server-supplied values (a.id, a.status, a.requestType).
findings.recommendation: Use data-* attributes and addEventListener instead of inline onclick.

findings.issue: Internal error messages from promotion pipeline exposed to API clients and stored in approval_comments.
findings.recommendation: Log internally, return generic user-facing message with correlation ID.

findings.issue: Missing DB CHECK constraint on notifications.type — accepts any TEXT.
findings.recommendation: Add CHECK (type IN ('approval_created','approval_approved','approval_rejected','info_requested','rule_promoted','pattern_flagged')).

findings.issue: No rate limiting on approvals/analytics/notifications routes. Bulk approve can trigger 40+ notification fan-outs.
findings.recommendation: Add per-user rate limiting consistent with sync routes.

findings.issue: PATTERN_SOURCE_FILE_KEYS includes 'decisions' but no scanDecisions function exists — wasted aggregation.
findings.recommendation: Remove 'decisions' from trigger set or implement scanDecisions.

findings.issue: Superseding logic unreachable — createApprovalRequest dedup guard prevents new record creation for duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Bypass dedup in supersede flow or implement supersede inside createApprovalRequest as transaction.

findings.issue: Inconsistent error log labels across route handlers.
findings.recommendation: Use consistent 'analytics error:' prefix.

findings.issue: Column name mismatch in getGateTrends — alias doesn't match actual column name.
findings.recommendation: Fix column alias to match actual schema.

findings.issue: Stats section duplicates list fetch.
findings.recommendation: Compute stats from existing ALL_APPROVALS array.

findings.issue: Redundant stats fetch from same endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Reuse loadApprovals data.

findings.issue: Initial CHECK constraint too narrow — requires 011 to widen.
findings.recommendation: Include all 7 types in initial CHECK.

findings.issue: Ignored return value from updateApprovalStatus in handleAddComment.
findings.recommendation: Check return value and handle failure.

findings.issue: contributedBy may be null when approval was auto-generated.
findings.recommendation: Default to system user or skip contributedBy when null.

findings.issue: Levenshtein O(m*n) with no length guard on long texts.
findings.recommendation: Short-circuit when length difference exceeds threshold.

findings.issue: Sequential notification dispatch blocks Lambda.
findings.recommendation: Use Promise.allSettled for parallel dispatch.

findings.issue: resourceType not validated against allowlist — any string accepted.
findings.recommendation: Define and validate against allowlist of resource types.

findings.issue: err.message stored in approval_comments visible to all team viewers.
findings.recommendation: Log server-side only, store generic message in DB.

findings.issue: Bearer tokens stored in sessionStorage — accessible to XSS payloads.
findings.recommendation: Use HttpOnly cookies or in-memory only storage.

findings.issue: bulkAction minor IDOR info disclosure — can determine if approval IDs exist in other teams by error message differences.
findings.recommendation: Pre-validate all IDs belong to teamId before processing.

findings.issue: Unvalidated approval content fields embedded into Markdown — could propagate stored XSS downstream.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize Markdown-sensitive characters before embedding.

findings.issue: loadStats() makes redundant API call identical to loadApprovals().
findings.recommendation: Compute stats from existing ALL_APPROVALS array.
